title: Barbershop Booking & Queue Management System
description: A comprehensive scheduling and real-time barber queue management system featuring point-of-sale integration and a full-coverage Pest API test suite.

challenges.problem: Preventing double-booking and concurrency conflicts during high-frequency appointment spikes.
challenges.solution: Implemented strict pessimistic database locks on active booking transactions combined with multi-layered Eloquent validation rules.

challenges.problem: Ensuring real-time synchronization of queue counters for customer and barber dashboards.
challenges.solution: Built an active polling and transactional event dispatch dispatcher that syncs frontend client slots with local database states instantaneously.

title: Graduated System CPRU
description: Digital transformation of alumni registration and management for CPRU Rajabhat University, transitioning paper-based workflows into a secure, scalable digital platform.

challenges.problem: Transitioning from paper-based alumni registration to a fully digital, auditable workflow with state integrity guarantees.
challenges.solution: Implemented a formal State Machine with atomic locks for payment verification, recording every state change in audit logs with actor, timestamp, and reason.

challenges.problem: Handling high-volume alumni data exports without server timeouts or memory exhaustion.
challenges.solution: Designed an async queue-based export system using Maatwebsite/Excel with chunk reading, delivering exports via temporary signed URLs.

title: University Database System
description: A full-featured PDF management and archiving platform for university academic documents, featuring role-based access control, dual file storage strategy, and Thai language support — built with Next.js 16, MongoDB, and Prisma.

challenges.problem: MongoDB lacks native JOINs, making relational queries with Prisma's MongoDB provider limited compared to SQL providers.
challenges.solution: Used embedded ObjectId references with Prisma's `include` for eager-loading related documents across User to Pdf and Category to Pdf relationships.

challenges.problem: The system must work both in development (no cloud blob token) and production (Vercel Blob), requiring a transparent fallback strategy.
challenges.solution: Abstracted storage behind a single `filePath` field; download logic checks if path is a blob URL or local path, then redirects or streams accordingly.

challenges.problem: Permissions must be enforced at middleware, Server Components, API routes, and client UI — four separate layers with consistent rules.
challenges.solution: Four-layer enforcement — proxy middleware blocks routes, Server Actions check auth() before mutations, API routes verify roles, client components conditionally render UI from session props.

challenges.problem: Thai characters require specific font loading, and MongoDB text search doesn't support Thai word segmentation natively.
challenges.solution: Loaded Noto Sans Thai via next/font, used regex-based matching on title/description instead of MongoDB text indexes to avoid Thai segmentation complexity.
